summaryZh: Budin 页面研究细胞及细胞器表面的分子过程，特别是膜脂组成与功能。研究开发用于细胞及完整生物体中膜脂组成研究的新工具，面向基础发现及健康、生物技术应用。
researchQuestions: 膜脂构件的分子功能是什么？

evidence.quote: itaybudin Exploring the private lives of membranes & their lipid building blocks
We use interdisciplinary approaches to understand and engineer the molecular processes that occur on the surfaces of cells and their organelles.
We are developing new tools to study membrane lipid composition in cells and whole organisms
Budin Lab – Laboratory of Lipid Biology and Cell Membrane Biophysics
Itay Budin ibudin@ucsd.edu | 858-246-5328 Titles Associate Professor of Biochemistry & Molecular Biophysics
which we then apply for fundamental discovery and applications in health and biotechnology.

We use interdisciplinary approaches to understand and engineer the molecular processes that occur on the surfaces of cells and their organelles. Cell membranes are defined by their lipid building blocks, whose complexity and molecular functions are only beginning to be understood.
